title: FLOOR ( 2.5, -2 ) is an error: a positive number with a negative significance

expected.error: FLOOR needs the number and the significance to have the same sign

source.quote: If number and significance have different signs, FLOOR returns the #NUM! error value.
source.supports: different signs are documented as an error

source.quote: The arguments number and significance must either both be positive, or both be negative.

derivation: 2.5 is positive and -2 is negative: different signs, so the documented outcome is an error.
alternative: Excel (2010 and later) only fails for a positive number with a negative significance, which is this case, so both readings agree here; an engine that ignores the sign of the significance would return 2.
